commit.message: feat(desktop): clarify Magi memory review layout

specification.objective: Make the Magi Desktop Pending Writes and Stored Memory review surfaces easier to scan and safer to interpret without changing Hermes memory semantics.

requirements.statement: Pending review presents a compact, clearly labeled queue summary and concise review guidance with no oversized KPI cards.
An empty Pending queue has one useful full-width empty state; when search has zero matches, the detail pane does not display an unfiltered or previously selected proposal.

Replacement operations show current and proposed content side by side at wide widths, stacked on narrow screens, including an explicit unavailable-source placeholder when necessary. Text remains selectable.

Stored Memory gives compact readable budget context and compaction preview explicitly compares current versus proposed entry and token measurements; labels communicate that applying is a separate write.
Existing searchable list, approval and deletion confirmations, stale/missing warnings, target switching, native vertical resizing, and Hermes REST contracts remain intact.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression tests prove a consolidated empty Pending state, filter-restricted selection, and compact status summary.
Regression tests prove responsive labeled before/after replacement rendering, including unavailable current text and selectable content.
Regression tests prove labeled current/proposed compaction statistics and preservation of an explicit Apply action.
All committed POLIS test and coverage gates, plus Magi plugin validation, pass.

invariants.statement: Hermes backend owns validation, pending approvals, memory updates and compaction apply; desktop UI uses existing REST routes.
Memory content is rendered as data, with selectable text and no HTML injection.
Desktop styling uses Hermes theme tokens and existing React/SDK primitives with no new dependency.
Existing viewer resize affordances and explicit confirmations are preserved.

forbidden_states.statement: Search with zero matching pending records displays detail or permits approval of a hidden proposal.
A missing replacement source is presented as if the prior entry were empty.
Compaction preview is automatically applied or appears to have already changed stored entries.
Tests and coverage are bypassed by altering the committed POLIS policy.

inputs.statement: Clean Magi main branch at HEAD 5ad30a0 and current Desktop UI implementation.
Magi existing Hermes Desktop SDK integration, responsive CSS utilities, and committed POLIS strict policy.

outputs.statement: Improved Pending Writes, Stored Memory and compaction preview UI in desktop/plugin.js.
Focused test coverage and validated POLIS Red/Green proof artifacts.

failure_semantics.statement: Missing data is labeled as unavailable; blank search results show no actionable proposal.
Existing errors and stale/missing target warnings remain visible without changing persistence behavior.
Any invalid POLIS scope, regression oracle, gate or Hermes plugin validation result blocks a completion claim.
